title: Hablaba and Hablo --- Two Ways of Looking
label: ch:aspect-not-time
canDo: I can say that the two past tenses differ in viewpoint rather than in time.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C48-dos-miradas: say whether the two pasts differ in when, and identify which one views an event from outside.
payoff.note: No new form. The chapter's work is to stop the reader looking for a rule about time, because there is not one.
